items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: At the time I was with the big band there

ctx.x: No, well, uh... Oliver had his own ideas, I mean, what I think. I don't recall that Oliver had anything written down, I mean, it's... No, he's never writing nothing down. He never did write nothing down. I never seen no music up there. I don't remember, maybe he did, but I doubt it.
What about, uh... Louis Armstrong? Did he have any arrangers when you worked with him?

Well, yeah, he had, uh... Chapper Willett, and, well, a few others, I mean. Yeah. That Chapper Willett was one of the main arrangers. At the time I was with the big band there, wasn't out of college then.
